refused_program.body:
set -e
git fetch "{upstream_remote}"
base=$(git merge-base "refs/remotes/{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" HEAD)
if comm -12 \
    <(git diff --name-only -z --no-renames "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
    <(git diff --name-only -z --no-renames "$base" "refs/remotes/{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) | grep -q .; then
  echo "local and upstream changes overlap; refusing automatic rebase" >&2
  exit 1
fi
git rebase "refs/remotes/{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}"
